title: Former DARPA man's 'hopeful monsters' hybrid proposal

tellings.quote:
I have met uh somebody
who's former DARPA he said he could tell
me this because it didn't then this
project that he was working on never got
approved never got went through but it
was a submission that he made and it was
um based on the work of this guy Richard
goldshmid

plain: A former scientist at DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, once submitted a proposal for a project based on the work of the biologist Richard Goldschmidt, whose idea of "hopeful monsters" is about sudden big leaps in how living things change, here turned toward creating hybrids. Michels tells this himself, from the man he met, who said he could talk about it because the project was never approved. If true, it would mean such ideas were at least pitched inside the Pentagon's research world.
